basis: Rambus’s October 30 release verifies Q3 2023 consolidated GAAP revenue of $105,298,000 against $112,244,000 a year earlier, a 6.19% decline. The cutoff was $106,631,800. July 31 remains the unresolved earlier candidate. A third-party transcript attributes a Q3 ASC 606 revenue range of $96 million to $102 million to CFO Desmond Lynch. That ceiling would qualify, but I could not verify the spoken figure in the recording or in an issuer document. The published component ranges allow a total as high as $108 million. October 30 therefore establishes the result while leaving the earliest disclosure date open.

coverage.detail: May 1, preceding earnings cycle. The Q1 release guided royalties to $37–43 million, product revenue to $50–56 million and contract and other revenue to $18–24 million. All three ranges applied to Q2, ending June 30.
The prior review checked the May 1 call for earlier Q3 guidance. Its third-party transcript discussed the memory-product transition. No consolidated Q3 ceiling was identified.

Rambus’s May 25 notice identifies two earlier events precisely. CEO Luc Seraphin was scheduled for BofA on June 7 at 3:20 p.m. Pacific and distinguished inventor Steven Woo for Rosenblatt on June 8 at noon Pacific. Rambus announced replays for both. The notice contains no financial range.

The BofA webcast-provider conference directory was inaccessible through the web tool. A host-specific search did not recover Seraphin’s recording, slides or prepared remarks. The content of his remarks remains unverified.
Rosenblatt’s own summit page lists Steven Woo among its June speakers. I could verify the program but could not recover his session audio, transcript or presentation from it.
July 20, proposed PHY IP sale. The expected immaterial revenue effect applied to the year. The Q3 reference concerned the expected closing date.

July 31, Q2 earnings release. The Q3 highs were $32 million of royalties, $53 million of product revenue and $23 million of contract and other revenue. Their $108 million sum exceeds the cutoff by $1,368,200. Licensing billings were a separate operating metric.

The full issuer webcast deck was readable. Its Q3 outlook slide gives the product and contract ranges in the table and the royalty range in footnote 1. It supplies no explicit $102 million consolidated ceiling.

Rambus directed listeners to investor relations for the July call audio and slides. It offered a one-week telephone replay under ID 439534. The issuer release itself does not print the alleged spoken range.
The public events page opened. Its accessible content yielded no July 31, 2023 recording or issuer transcript.
The quarterly-results archive opened, but its accessible content exposed no Q2 2023 audio link.
A direct event-page lookup using the issuer’s earnings-event naming pattern returned HTTP 404.
The historical snapshot lookup was inaccessible through the web tool. I could not recover the contemporary webcast destination this way.

This readable secondary transcript attributes the $96–102 million Q3 ASC 606 forecast to Lynch and says the guidance included the PHY IP business. The alleged high is $4,631,800 below the cutoff. This is the specific unresolved claim from the prior review.
A separate archive lists the July 31 call with a play-audio option. I could read the transcript page but could not verify the spoken passage in the recording.
August 11. The $100 million announcement concerned an accelerated share repurchase and supplied no Q3 revenue forecast.
September 7. On announcing the completed sale, Rambus affirmed Q3 guidance and specifically referred to the July 31 Form 8-K. It supplied no consolidated numeric ceiling.
October 11. Rambus scheduled its October 30 results call without reporting preliminary revenue.
October 30. The consolidated statement of operations reports total revenue in thousands of 105,298 and 112,244 for the three months ended September 30, 2023 and 2022, respectively.

The 10-Q confirms the PHY IP sale closed September 6 and remained in continuing operations. Rambus recorded the divestiture gain separately from revenue, so the published prior-year revenue comparative applies without adjustment.

publication_date_evidence: Rambus dated its Q2 release July 31, 2023 and scheduled the public call for 2:00 p.m. Pacific that day. That establishes the opportunity for disclosure. The missing evidence is primary confirmation of the consolidated numeric range delivered on the call. The Q3 results release itself is dated October 30, 2023, ahead of the November 3 Form 10-Q.
primary_source_reason: Secondary transcript identified during the frozen scorers post-lock source review. The dated evidence must be verifiable on a primary issuer source.
